question.text: In the circuit shown, the value of $\beta$ of the transistor is 48 . If the base current supplied is $200 \mu \mathrm{A}$, what is the voltage at the terminal $\mathrm{Y}$?

solution.text:
Hint:
$\beta=48$
$l_{B}=200 \mu \mathrm{A}$
$I_{C}=\beta I_{B}=48 \times 200 \times 10^{-6}$
$V_{\mathrm{CC}}=I_{C} R_{C}+V_{C E} \therefore V_{C E}=5-\left(96 \times 10^{-4}\right) \times 500=5-4.8=0.2$ volt
